name: Falling In Love
overview: Scripture reveals that falling in love is part of God's design for human companionship, as He declared it is not good for man to be alone and provided a suitable helper for him (Genesis 2:18). The blessing of a prudent wife is from the Lord, symbolizing favor and a good inheritance beyond material wealth (Proverbs 18:22; 19:14). True love reflects divine qualities where mercy, truth, righteousness, and peace meet (Psalms 85:10), and believers are called to maintain their first love with God, guarding against spiritual neglect (Revelation 2:4). Faith in prayer also plays a vital role in receiving what one desires, underscoring the importance of trusting God in matters of the heart (Mark 11:24).
